setting: the walk down the hill from the hospital at twenty past eight on a wet sunday, boots on grit and standing water, one bus going up past him, his voice half in his collar, a long pause where he loses the thread and then starts again about a man in bay three

his kitchen on a tuesday afternoon, a pan at a low rolling simmer, a lid set down on a counter, the tap running for two seconds and stopping, three sentences delivered flat with a spoon tapping the pan rim on the last one

a school corridor at ten past one, a wall of mounted boards behind her and a corridor echo, a door banging twice a long way off, two boys going past mid-argument, her voice quick and pitched low so as not to carry

the third morning of four, walking home in the dark before the light comes, very slow footsteps, a gritting lorry somewhere below the hill, a long silence in the middle where he only breathes, and one flat sentence at the end about the bag on his step
